title: Hearty Juicy French Chicken Tarte Tatin
description: A classic French dish with a twist, featuring chicken, vin-santo, and a hint of mustard, all in a low-fat friendly tarte tatin format
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch
In a large bowl, whisk together the vin-santo, mustard, honey, thyme, and garlic
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the vin-santo mixture
Arrange the chicken in a single layer on the pastry dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the chicken, pressing gently to seal
Brush the pastry with the olive oil
Bake the tarte tatin for 35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through
